# Cryptographic Key

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:CryptographicKey`](gmeow-CryptographicKey.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/CryptographicKey>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/trust`](../../slices/trust.md)

A public key, certificate, or key material bound to an agent's identity — the thing a signature is made with and a certification vouches for.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:CryptographicKey`](gmeow-CryptographicKey.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
